subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils v2 01/10] nfsdctl: sync nfsd_netlink.h with the kernel

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch updates the nfsd_netlink.h header file in the nfs-utils package to match the latest version from the Linux kernel. It imports new attributes related to rpcbind registration, including NFSD_A_SERVER_SOCK_USERSPACE_RPCBIND and NFSD_A_SERVER_SOCK_RPCBIND, which allow a caller to own an rpcbind registration. The patch also updates the configure.ac file to use these new attributes when determining whether to use the system's netlink headers or the imported ones. This change is necessary because some systems may have older kernel versions that do not include these new attributes in their netlink headers.
